evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list names the Center for High Pressure Science and Technology Advanced Research (HPSTAR) among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP), and the US Commerce Department listed it in 2020 as one of ten entities owned by, operated by or directly affiliated with CAEP, the complex responsible for researching, developing and testing China’s nuclear weapons.

HPSTAR describes itself as a state public institution set up with central government approval (preparations from 2012, formally in 2015) and funded by the Ministry of Finance, with branches in Beijing, Shanghai and Changchun; its own description does not mention CAEP.
